mapper.select: SELECT id, region, hash, note_type, note_text, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_project_note_db ORDER BY region ASC, updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, region, hash, note_type, note_text, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_project_note_db WHERE region = #{region} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, region, hash, note_type, note_text, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_project_note_db WHERE region = #{region} AND hash = #{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_project_note_db ( region, hash, note_type, note_text ) VALUES ( #{region}, #{hash}, #{noteType}, #{noteText} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE note_type = VALUES(note_type), note_text = VALUES(note_text)
